post_replacement_validation_procedure.action: Before any change, satisfy open rollback/config/resource/data-side-effect prerequisites and obtain explicit operator replacement approval; retain source hashes, PID/start/listener, configuration provenance without exposing credentials, and old artifact manifest. Arrange drain/outage window.

Operator rechecks PID/start/command/listener, gracefully stops the verified original console/service by its owner-approved method, then confirms port8000 free. Never act on a stale remembered PID or launch a competing server.

Use the reviewed bootstrap command only after exact environment and database side-effect approval; retain stdout/stderr/traceback in a fresh evidence directory. Capture new PID/start/command/cwd/interpreter and socket owner.

GET /health and /v1/runtime/attestation through real loopback port8000. Require healthy response, expected final source snapshot9916..., new matching process identity and registered-code binding. Preserve non-transitive attestation limitations; no full build/model-weight claim.

GET /openapi.json: verify POST /v1/chat, GET /v1/health, GET /v1/control-plane/model-status, GET /v1/control-plane/models, POST /v1/control-plane/model-selection. Inspect /console and compiled asset HTTP separately because static routes may be absent from OpenAPI. Preserve status/body/fingerprints.

Verify Console root and /console render expected compiled index/JS, New Chat client state and model-status. Unauthenticated models access must follow existing rejection contract; operator-authenticated inventory/status must succeed using legitimate existing credentials without writing them to evidence.

With explicit mutation approval only, validate model-selection revision/conflict handling and chat consumption of selected installed model. Inventory has only one historically observed real model; do not claim two-real-model switching. Record final operator selection impact.

With explicit provider/memory-write approval only, POST controlled greeting and substantive /v1/chat requests. Validate existing public response contract/request IDs, human answer, grounding/trust behavior, provider receipt correlated to process/source/config/model and native semantic/RAG provenance. Fixture retrieval cannot close production RAG; provider model name cannot attest loaded weights. Record errors and traceback without removing prior evidence.

On failed approved replacement, operator stops only its verified new process and runs the verified previous artifact using its recorded interpreter/configuration on the free approved port. Compare health, process/build, routes and required behavior to prior baseline. No exact rollback command is available now; do not authorize replacement while this gate is open. Database restore is a separate data-change authorization, never implicit.
Keep V1 HOLD while CC05, CC06, native RAG, security and deployment gates remain open. Successful alignment closes only the specified runtime mismatch, not V1 acceptance.
